name: Team AI-Usage Assessment
tagline: Reads session logs to assess how each teammate uses AI, and where to improve.
description: Analyzes local AI session transcripts to assess prompting quality, skill usage and repeated mistakes for each teammate, producing a structured improvement report.

page.objective: Raise the whole team's AI effectiveness with concrete, evidence-based feedback.
page.problem: It is hard to know who is using AI well and what to coach without reading everything.
page.solution: Automated analysis of session logs into a per-person assessment.

highlights.headline: Turns a teammate's Claude Code session logs into a coaching report.
points: Reads local .jsonl transcripts and scores prompting quality and concept understanding.
Flags repeated mistakes and information gaps with concrete recommendations.
Already run for real teammates — reports exist for Dhanushya and Surya.
